MORE: The Board of Directors at its meeting held on August 10, 2026 has approved the following: 1. Un-audited financials for June 30, 2026; 2. Declaration of first interim dividend; 3. Approval for Unsecured NCD issuance; 4. Draft Notice of 33rd AGM and cut off date.
